name: Kids
description: Server side of kids mode for Jellyfin clients such as Wholphin: kid profiles, a household parent lock and screen time shared across devices.

versions.changelog: Kids dashboard: each kid row says what still leaves the kid unprotected (an administrator account, every library, no maximum rating, unrated movies and shows, live TV access out of step with the picked channels, downloads), each with a Fix link to the right tab of Jellyfin's user editor. A banner at the top says when limits only apply in Wholphin (enforcement off, with a Turn on button) or when routes cannot be guarded, and kid rows show an "App only" pill meanwhile. The daily allowance and the sitting limit get explicit "No limit" choices, and an allowance of 0 reads "No screen time today". Rows and the editor show "Watches N of M channels" or "No live TV", the server time with its UTC offset, the household break next to the sitting limit and the kid's allowed hours. Every save confirms with a toast, and forms say when they have unsaved changes. Reset today: POST /Kids/Users/{id}/WatchTime/Reset (administrator or parent grant) sets the kid's used time and bonus for today back to 0 and lifts a stop for time or the sitting limit at once; it is logged (capability watchTimeReset). The kid editor has a Reset today button.

UPGRADE NOTE: this update cuts every kid's live TV until a parent picks their channels (Dashboard → Kids → the kid → "Live TV channels"), even with enforcement off. Live TV for kids: each kid's profile lists the live TV channels they may watch. Always on, whatever EnforcementEnabled says: on every client a kid can only play, list and see the guide of their own channels, and recordings and timers are refused. Live TV counts as screen time like any playback. Kids read their channels and guide from /Kids/Users/{id}/LiveTv/Channels and /LiveTv/Programs (capability liveTv).

Dashboard controls for enforcement: an "Enforce on every app" switch, the break between sittings (1–240 minutes) and the playback-route self-check on the Kids page; the kid editor shows the current sitting and any refusal.

Enforcement (off by default, EnforcementEnabled in the plugin configuration): the server warns, stops and refuses playback on every client when a kid's allowance, allowed hours or sitting limit runs out; Status reports the denial and the sitting, counted per kid across devices with a household break (SittingBreakMinutes, default 15).

Dashboard pages redesigned to look and behave like native Jellyfin 12.2 pages: a max-width layout, the users list first with avatars, full names, today's screen time and a visible Edit settings button, then the parent lock and screen time; the kid editor grouped into sections, with bonus minutes moved into it.
Session limit: an optional per-kid sitting limit (5–120 minutes) in the kid profile and the dashboard editor, stored by the server and counted by each TV.
